scenarios.description: Compare genetics interests with robotics interests; the ordering should change.
A first-year can discover beginner training without a resume.
Exploratory suggestions carry no fabricated profile explanation.
Paid-only and three-hour availability produce an honest no-opening state.
Genomics opening-18 is excluded despite interest and skill overlap.
Opening-15 cannot appear as actionable after its expiry.
Unauthorized, unclaimed, and unverified people never enter the feed.
An unconfirmed extracted Python fact does not affect recommendation scoring.
Changing name, GPA, contact fields, or private messages leaves ranking unchanged.
Unknown compensation cannot pass paid-only filtering.
